Leading Performance and Technology for Professional UserMILWAUKEE, WI - Milwaukee Tool continues their dedication to delivering leading performance with the addition of the M18 FUEL™ 7-1/4” Circular Saw, designed uniquely for the professional carpenter, remodeler, and general contractor. Utilizing cutting-edge cordless technology, this saw delivers best-in-class performance, empowering users to tackle even the most demanding tasks with ease and accomplish them with increased efficiency. Milwaukee's latest circular saw ensures professionals experience unmatched performance, alongside enhanced ergonomics, a robust feature set, and extended run time. With the introduction of our new M18 FUEL™ 7-1/4” Circular Saw, Milwaukee is pushing the limits of capabilities on the jobsite," explained Tyson Apfelbeck, Senior Vice President of Product Marketing. "Featuring the next generation POWERSTATE™ Brushless Motor that harnesses the powerful capabilities of our FORGE Batteries, we are delivering our most powerful circular saw solution, continuing to drive productivity and performance on the job.” The new POWERSTATE™ Brushless Motor delivers 6,000 RPM, maintaining high speed under load, providing users the ability to complete their most demanding applications efficiently. The latest in REDLINK PLUS™ Electronics ensures maximum tool performance and protection from overload, overheating, and over-discharge. Paired with the M18 REDLITHIUM FORGE HD12.0, the saw delivers 50% more power when compared to the M18 REDLITHIUM™ HIGH OUTPUT™ HD12.0. Designed for comfortable all-day use, the M18 FUEL™ 7- ¼" Circular saw provides enhanced ergonomics in a more compact size. The lightweight design at only 7.9lbs generates the best power-to-weight ratio in its class. The new M18™ REDLITHIUM™ FORGE™ HD12.0 delivers up to 750 cuts per charge, reducing downtime on the jobsite, and keeping users productive. The M18 FUEL™ 7- ¼" Circular saw provides professional users increased productivity, ease of use, and a broad application range. Positive bevel detents at 22.5° and 45° as well as positive depth detents at ½”, ¾”, and 1-1/2” reduce downtime and deliver precise cuts for the user. The improved cut line visibility provides easy and accurate cutting for professionals at all angles. The premium cut depth at 2-5/8” allows users to cut 3x material in one pass. Additional improvements include an electric blade brake, LED work light, rafter hook, new blade wrench, as well as all-magnesium guards and shoes. These elements keep the user productive and provide durability to handle the toughest jobsite conditions. In addition, Milwaukee introduces their new Thick Kerf Framing Circular Saw Blades, which offer the straightest cuts and longer life in wood. These blades are designed with a High Performance Thick Kerf, allowing you to get the straightest rip cuts and ultimate stability in softwoods, hardwoods, lumber, and laminated woods. The diamond venting pattern allows for cool cutting and improved chip ejection while the cobalt-infused carbide teeth stay sharper longer. The Thick Kerf Framing Blades are optimized for the most powerful cordless saws, providing strong performance even at the highest RPMs. Milwaukee is committed to improving productivity by providing performance-driven and trade-focused solutions so users can perform an entire day's work on one battery system. The M18 FUEL™ 7-¼" Circular Saw is fully compatible with the entire M18™ line, now offering more than 250 solutions. The M18 FUEL™ 7-¼" Circular Saw is fully compatible with the entire M18™ line, now offering more than 250 solutions. Specifications M18 FUEL™ 7-¼" Circular Saw (2834-20 & 2834-21HD) RPM: 6000 Peak Power: 3000 Cut Depth (90): 2-5/8” Cut Depth (45): 2-1/16” Max Bevel Degrees: 57 Height: 8.5” Length: 14” Width: 7.4” Weight (Bare Tool): 7.9 Weight (with REDLITHIUM™ FORGE™ HD12.0 Battery): 11.2lbs Warranty: 5 Years (Tool), 3 Years (Battery) Bare-Tool Includes: (1) M18 FUEL 7-¼" Circular Saw, (1) 7-¼” 24T Thick Kerf Framing Blade, Wrench, Dust Port Kit Includes: (1) M18 FUEL 7-¼" Circular Saw, (1) 7-¼” 24T Thick Kerf Framing Blade, Wrench, Dust Port (1) REDLITHIUM™ FORGE™ HD12.0 Battery, (1) M18/M12 Multi-Volt Rapid Charger, Contractor Bag MSRP M18 FUEL™ 7-¼" Circular Saw-Tool Only (2834-20)-$249 M18 FUEL™ 7-¼" Circular Saw Kit (2834-21HD)- $449 7-¼” 24T Thick Kerf Framing Blade (48-40-740)- $11.97 7-¼” 24T Thick Kerf Framing Blade 2 Pack (48-40-0742)- $22.97 7-¼” 24T Thick Kerf Framing Blade 10 Pack (48-41-0740)- $11.97 7-¼” 24T Thick Kerf Framing Blade 25 Pack (48-40-2740)- $275 About Milwaukee Tool Milwaukee Tool, founded in 1924, is a global leader in delivering innovative solutions to the professional construction trades that increase productivity and safety. Milwaukee® is known for their world-leading M12™, M18™, and MX FUEL™ cordless systems, the ground-breaking performance of their cordless innovations, safety solutions, battery-powered outdoor power equipment, jobsite lighting and clean-up, time-saving accessories, and innovative hand tool and PACKOUT™ Modular Storage products. The company is dedicated to delivering a steady stream of advanced, trade-specific solutions. Milwaukee Tool is a Brookfield, Wisconsin-based subsidiary of Techtronic Industries Co. Ltd.
